about.zh: 只用 ComfyUI 自带的节点重画圈出的地方，没装别的包时用。
about.en: ComfyUI's own nodes only: for when the packs above are missing.

source.zh: ComfyUI 官方的局部重绘做法

after: The sampler repaints only the area, at denoise 0.5 so it keeps the picture's look (higher changes more). The marked area's size becomes the size of what is painted there: mark tightly around it (a hand, not the arm beside it). Keep denoise 0.35-0.5 to fix something and keep its size and pose; 0.7 and up paints a new thing that fills the whole mark. Hands and faces vary a lot from seed to seed: run_workflow with batch 4 and let the user pick, rather than judging one. Then run_workflow.
